The '''Crymorah syndicate''' was a major underworld operation, considered on par with other large syndicates such as the [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutts]], the [[Pyke Syndicate/Legends|Pykes]], and the [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]]. The Crymorah syndicate was centrally located in the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="Mask" /> 

Similar to its relationship with the Hutts, [[Galactic Empire/Legends|the Empire]] maintained an unofficial agreement with Crymorah Syndicate.<ref>[[Stay on Target (sourcebook)|''Stay on Target'' sourcebook]]</ref>
